Standing desks are generally better for health than sitting when they reduce prolonged sedentary time and encourage movement, with evidence showing lower risks of heart disease, obesity, and diabetes and modest gains in calorie burn and productivity [d1,d2,d3,d4]. These sources consistently agree that standing desks outperform sitting for health outcomes in office settings.
